    Dungeons¶

    Where magic pools, the dead walk, and fortune waits for those brave enough — or desperate enough — to claim it.

    Dungeons are locations of concentrated magical energy across Ge'or. They are not merely ruins or caves. They are living ecosystems — places where magic, history, and the black agent interact to create environments of perpetual danger and reward.

    How Dungeons Form¶

    Ge'or is a world steeped in thousands of years of magical activity. Great wizards, legendary figures, dragon lords, and Angels all left their mark — constructing fortresses, laboratories, temples, and vaults. These places were saturated with magic.

    When abandoned, the magic does not dissipate. It pools. And magic attracts the black agent.

    The Black Agent Connection¶

    The black agent was dispersed into Ge'or's atmosphere during the glassing of the 157th Colony research stations. While Dragonreach holds the largest concentration — drawn by Melberior's suicide spell — trace amounts exist everywhere.

    When magic accumulates in an abandoned place, it draws the black agent to it — like iron to a magnet. The concentration is far lower than Dragonreach. It cannot create Fallen Dragons or hiveminds. But it can do other things:

    • Spirits of the Dead — people who died nearby may have fragments of their consciousness reawakened. These spirits are not full souls — they are echoes, memories given form. Ghost-like, immaterial, sometimes aware, sometimes repeating the same actions for centuries.
    • Zombies and Skeletons — bodies buried near dungeons may rise, animated by the black agent's interaction with residual life force. They are mindless, driven by instinct, dangerous in numbers.
    • Mutated Species — creatures living in or near dungeons change over generations. Wargs grow larger. Spiders develop venom that paralyzes. Beetles develop armored carapaces. These mutations create monsters — not to be confused with demon race beings, who are a civilized species.

    Endless and Self-Renewing¶

    Dungeons do not run out. The magic that creates them is self-sustaining — a feedback loop of accumulated energy drawing more black agent, which creates more phenomena, which generates more magic. New dungeons form whenever enough magic concentrates in one place.

    This makes dungeons an endless resource — and an endless hazard.

    The Adventurer Economy¶

    Dungeons are the engine of Ge'or's adventurer economy.

    What Comes Out¶

    • Romanium — the scarcest resource, found in ancient caches and laboratory ruins
    • Gold — dragon hoards, imperial tribute, temple treasuries
    • Relics — artifacts from previous ages: weapons, tools, magical items, lost spells
    • Historical artifacts — tablets, records, and objects that predate the Great Divergence
    • Biological specimens — mutated creatures, rare reagents, black agent samples

    Who Goes In¶

    Adventurers range from desperate peasants seeking one good find to professional guild members with years of training. Most die. The few who succeed bring back enough wealth to inspire the next wave.

    The flow of goods from dungeons sustains entire regional economies. Towns near active dungeon sites become trading hubs. Merchants specialize in dungeon salvage. Augamouth and Astravayne, near Dragonreach, are prime examples — their entire economies revolve around the flow of treasure from the mountain.

    Adventurer Guilds¶

    Adventurer guilds exist across Ge'or as formal organizations that regulate, train, and profit from dungeon exploration. They hold political power in many regions — controlling access to valuable sites, taxing recovered goods, and maintaining standing forces.

    Guilds rank adventurers by experience and success. The highest-ranked members become legends. Most remain anonymous, their names recorded only in guild ledgers marked "deceased."

    Connections¶

    • Powered by: Accumulated magic + atmospheric Black Agent
    • Creates: Spirits, undead, mutated monsters
    • Economy: Romanium, gold, relics, artifacts
    • Related: Adventurer Guilds, Dragonreach, Goldenborn's Caldera, The Draconic War
    • Key towns: Augamouth, Astravayne
